must: Validate producer schema at application boot.
Fail fast if producer.service/kind violates allowlists or forbidden fields are present.

break_glass: Activation MUST require 2-person rule and be time-boxed.
Every bypassed action MUST emit P0 audit logs.
deployments: Deployments MUST enter maintenance/drain mode per DMSC-1 before schema migrations or disruptive changes.
Deployments MUST be abortable; rollback MUST be a first-class plan.
restore_drills: Automated restore drill MUST run at least every 30 days and record evidence.
Restore drill MUST validate tenant isolation invariants (TEN-1) and canonical error envelopes (ERR-1).

must: Expose producer metadata as read-only fields in telemetry/event envelopes.
Propagate request_id for public entry points; producer is not a request identifier.

change_log.summary: Introduce Legislative Bypass Protocol for emergency crypto/profile rotations without CI lockout (time-boxed dual-pin window, audited approvals, mandatory cleanup).

changes: P0 Fix: Changed invalid_producer_schema error_code from ERRBADREQUEST to ERR_BAD_REQUEST (ERR-1 canonical format).
P0 Fix: Changed forbidden_field_present error_code from ERRINTERNALERROR to ERR_BAD_REQUEST (client schema violations are not internal errors).
P1 Fix: Added instance_id format constraint (uuid_v7) with deterministic exception for Kubernetes pod names (RFC 1123 DNS label pattern).
Restored CS-0@2.2.0 snake_case envelope keys and suite_schema format.

Enforced ticketing.* namespace via regex + explicit allowlist (v42.* rejected by construction).
Pinned TEN-1 min_version to 1.6.9 and removed CANON-1 dependency (BP-0 AP-NO-CANON-DEP).
Added 'ticketing.tickets' to producer_service_allowlist to legalize the Ticket domain as a first-class producer service under PROD-1 producer sovereignty.

change_log.summary: Upgrade PROD-1 from naming/namespace governance to production survival constitution: DR (PITR/WAL), break-glass protocol, infra immutability, health endpoints, graceful draining, and game-day discipline.

changes: Phase 8: Legislative quorum identities integration for bypass authorization (QUORUM-1).
Bypass evidence schema v2: quorum signatures bind incident_id + bypass_transcript_sha256.
Isolation invariant non-optional: distinct security boundaries required.

deterministic_exception.reason: Kubernetes pod names are permitted as deterministic alternatives to UUIDv7

dependencies.reason: Blueprint baseline bundle structure + deterministic CI gates.
Gate authoring posture and enforcement boundary.
Multi-tenant isolation and org_id truth; break-glass must not violate tenancy.
Authorization model + emergency (break-glass) capabilities and actor identity.
Canonical error envelope and code discipline for denials and incident flows.
Producer metadata placement in event envelopes.
OTel alignment, audit/event logging requirements, and bounded-label requirements.
Drain/deploy/maintenance coordination; graceful shutdown and incident freeze semantics.
Operational budgets and quality controls (latency/error/queue bounds).
Fail-fast lock discipline and hot-path concurrency expectations.
Crypto primitives, offline hydration manifest envelope law, and signing/canonicalization pins.

Ash 3.x terminology, multitenancy conventions, and resource boundary discipline.

forbidden_field_present.note: Forbidden fields are client schema violations, not internal errors

events_and_ordering.rule: PROD-1 does not emit domain events; it governs producer identity metadata and operational invariants.

restore_drill_requirements: Restore to isolated sandbox from backups + WAL and run automated integrity checks.
Record drill evidence as an immutable audit record (OBS-1 audit trail + artifact hash).

pitr.definition: Platform MUST support point-in-time recovery to any timestamp within retention window.

regional_dr.scope: region loss / full rebuild from object storage archives

notes: Nightly pg_dump alone is forbidden for production DR. PITR requires WAL archiving.
WAL archive destination MUST be immutable object storage (versioned buckets) with server-side encryption.

constraints: Bypass MUST be explicit per-action and MUST NOT allow arbitrary reads across org_id boundaries.
Bypass MUST require actor capability 'admin.break_glass.execute' and an active break-glass token.
Bypass MUST force stronger logging (P0 audit) for each bypassed action.
ash_policy_bypass.intent: Only during active break-glass window, allow a constrained set of corrective actions otherwise denied by normal Ash policies.

audit.immutability: Audit records MUST be append-only and MUST NOT be deletable.

http_drain.note: Use drainers compatible with your server (Bandit/Cowboy) and load balancer connection draining.

oban_drain.note: Workers MUST checkpoint progress; shutdown MUST stop accepting new jobs before grace window.

liveness.semantics: BEAM VM is responsive; does not check downstream dependencies.

readiness.semantics: Can serve traffic; MUST check DB connectivity + Redis reachability + queue backpressure.

key_isolation_law.text: Quorum keys MUST reside in distinct security partitions (separate HSM slots or KMS accounts). Verification of 'Two-Person Rule' is invalid if keys share an administrative boundary.

evidence.notes: Attestations MUST be verified against QUORUM-1 pinned signer identities. CI roles are forbidden signers.

incident_voiding_rule.must: Bypass evidence MUST only be accepted while incident_state == 'open'. Once closed, the bypass is cryptographically void for future changes because signatures bind incident_id and transcript.
incident_voiding_rule.note: CI cannot verify external incident systems; enforcement is via binding signatures to incident_id + transcript and time-boxed window.

non_derogable_invariants: Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS) MUST NOT be disabled or bypassed in production under any circumstances.
Direct UPDATE/DELETE on immutable finance tables (LED-1 LedgerPosting/LedgerEntry; PAY-4 payout postings) is FORBIDDEN; corrections must be additive via reversing postings.
Ticket credential immutability (TKT-1 TicketCredential status history) MUST NOT be overwritten; revocation must be append-only and auditable.
Any break-glass bypass that would violate the above MUST fail-closed and emit an audit incident.
legislative_bypass_protocol.notes: This protocol is for emergency rotations only. Routine upgrades MUST follow standard governance and cannot use the bypass window.
legislative_bypass_protocol.objective: Enable emergency, time-boxed cryptographic and profile rotations (e.g., PQC/vulnerability response) without suite self-lockout, while preserving auditability and deterministic rollback/cleanup.

policy_isolation_invariant.must: Primary quorum signers MUST be in distinct security boundaries (e.g., separate cloud accounts) per QUORUM-1.

suite_lockout_prevention_rules: During an active bypass window, affected contracts MUST allow BOTH old and new artifact pins for the declared targets.
The bypass window MUST be time-boxed and MUST be closed by a cleanup patch removing the old pins.
All bypass activity MUST be traceable to an incident_id and dual approvals.
Bypass attestations MUST be cryptographically bound to incident_id; replay across incidents is invalid.
Bypass attestations MUST include bypass_transcript_sha256 derived from the exact target pin change set.

operational_game_days.evidence: Each game day MUST produce an immutable audit record.
scenarios: Kill primary DB node and verify failover + app reconnect.
Simulate Redis outage and verify degraded-mode behavior and lock fallback.
Rotate signing keys and verify offline scanners remain valid through grace overlap.

rules: producer.service MUST be a member of producer_service_allowlist.
producer.kind MUST be a member of producer_kind_enum.
Producer metadata MUST NOT contain any forbidden_fields (these keys MUST NOT appear in producer identity, instance_id claims, or static service metadata).
Producer metadata MUST be derived at boot from environment/config and MUST NOT be mutated per-request.

semver_rules.major: Breaking changes to required fields, naming rules, or allowlist semantics.
semver_rules.minor: Additive allowlist/enum expansions or optional fields.
semver_rules.patch: Non-breaking tightening or schema compliance fixes.

observability.rule: Production systems MUST provide audit-grade observability: bounded labels, immutable incident audit logs, and actionable SLO telemetry.

boundaries: PROD-1 is normative for production posture and operational invariants; it does not define business-domain behavior (orders, pricing, tickets).
PROD-1 does not define cryptographic primitives (SEC-1 owns crypto); PROD-1 references SEC-1 for signing/canonicalization where needed.
PROD-1 does not define per-resource authorization rules; IAM-1 owns access models. PROD-1 defines the break-glass protocol that IAM-1 must expose and OBS-1 must audit.
purpose: Define non-negotiable production survivability laws (DR + emergency access + integrity) for the Ticketing platform.
Define deterministic producer identity and namespace rules used across event envelopes, logs, metrics, and audit trails.
Define enforceable operational invariants that block deployments when violated ("no theatre" gates + pinned constants).

security.rule: Security posture MUST be deterministic, auditable, and compatible with emergency operations (break-glass) without violating tenancy.

summary: Production-grade survival, disaster recovery, and emergency access laws for Ticketing. Defines immutable producer identity rules plus operational physics: PITR/WAL archiving, RPO/RTO targets, graceful shutdown/drain discipline, break-glass policy bypass protocol, and infrastructure immutability/secret rotation requirements.

notes: All public entry points MUST require org_id context; producer fields MUST NOT replace org_id.
Producer payload MUST NOT contain org_id, tenant_id, or other tenant identifiers.
tenancy.rule: Producer identity is system metadata and MUST NOT be used as a tenancy key.
